title: Heartbeat Daemon + Quota-aware 调度 + Run History Event Ledger
description:
EPIC-166 — 借鉴 loopx 心跳调度 + 6 层 quota 系统 + append-only event ledger, 给 KALLAX 补 daemon 自动化能力.

**Context**: 主公 2026-08-05 review loopx 后拍板 (P0, 解决 Master 派单瓶颈) — 当前 KALLAX 心跳 5 问 (Q1-Q5) 需人工触发, 无 daemon; ticket 数量增长时 Master 成为派单瓶颈; 无 quota-aware 调度; 无持久化 event ledger, PR 描述碎片化. 跟 loopx 对比见 confluence/decisions/loopx-vs-kallax-architecture-gap-2026-08-05.md.

**设计 (跟 loopx `loopx quota should-run` + heartbeat-prompt + run-history 1:1)**:
1. `scripts/heartbeat/heartbeat-daemon.sh` — 后台 daemon, 定时调 `quota should-run`, 返回 next allowed transition (跟 loopx 1:1)
2. `scripts/heartbeat/quota.sh` — quota-aware 调度 (per-ticket compute quota + spend ledger + eligible/throttled/paused 状态机, 跟 loopx 6 层 quota 1:1)
3. `scripts/heartbeat/scheduler-hint.sh` — P0/P1/P2 priority stack (truth-safety / human-decision / product-UX)
4. `scripts/heartbeat/run-history.sh` — append-only event ledger (4 类 event: work/decision/accounting/evidence, 跟 loopx 1:1)
5. `state/run-history.jsonl` — ledger 持久化 (append-only, work/decision/accounting/evidence 4 类 event)

**0 增 Rule, 0 改 source code 之外**: 跟 EPIC-161 retrospective-routine 1:1 pattern (6 阶段), 复用 immutable check scripts 退出码契约.

**跟 BE-14 关系**: 不冲突.
**跟 EPIC-054-A 关系**: 不冲突.
**跟 EPIC-161 关系**: 互补 (EPIC-161 = 阶段性回顾, EPIC-166 = 实时 daemon).
**跟 EPIC-023-C 关系**: 跟 4 北极星 metric 直接打通 (daemon 自动 emit work/decision/accounting event).
acceptance: AC1: scripts/heartbeat/heartbeat-daemon.sh 后台 daemon (跟 loopx heartbeat-prompt 1:1), 定时调 quota should-run, 返回 next allowed transition, 默认 60s 间隔 (可调)
AC2: daemon 退出码契约: 0=PASS (continue), 1=FAIL (stop, 报 Master), 2=BLOCKED-env (跟 scan-dead-code 1:1)
AC3: scripts/heartbeat/quota.sh per-ticket compute quota + spend ledger + eligible/throttled/paused 状态机 (跟 loopx 6 层 quota 1:1)
AC4: scripts/heartbeat/scheduler-hint.sh P0/P1/P2 priority stack (truth-safety / human-decision / product-UX, 跟 loopx 1:1)
AC5: scripts/heartbeat/run-history.sh append-only event ledger (4 类 event: work/decision/accounting/evidence, 跟 loopx 1:1)
AC6: state/run-history.jsonl 持久化 (append-only, schema 跟 loopx 1:1: event_type / agent_id / ticket_id / timestamp / payload)
AC7: .claude/heartbeat-conductor.md + .claude/heartbeat-performer.md 已有 — 跟 daemon 集成 (daemon 自动调用, 不再手动 Q1-Q5)
AC8: install.sh Omnibus 加 daemon install + daemon start 阶段 (跟 EPIC-160 1:1 pattern)
AC9: tests/integration/heartbeat-daemon.test.sh ≥8 case PASS (daemon start / stop / quota should-run / P0/P1/P2 优先级 / 4 类 event / ledger append-only / 安装集成 / 跟北极星 metric 联动)
AC10: tests/integration/quota-scheduler.test.sh ≥5 case PASS (eligible / throttled / paused / spend ledger / priority stack)
AC11: tests/integration/run-history-ledger.test.sh ≥5 case PASS (work event / decision event / accounting event / evidence event / append-only 不变)
AC12: vitest sentinel + 5-Level Verify L1-L5 PASS
AC13: docs/reference/heartbeat-daemon-2026-08-05.md 加用法 + 6 quota 层详解 + 4 类 event schema
AC14: CLAUDE.md 加 EPIC-166 引用 (跟 EPIC-161 retrospective-routine 1:1 pattern, 互补不冲突)
AC15: 0 改 source code, 0 增 Rule (跟 EPIC-161 1:1 pattern)
AC16: daemon 跟 EPIC-023-C 北极星 4 指标打通 (自动 emit work/accounting event)
